加速度
陀螺仪
振动控制
动态传感器
如何使用ArkTS订阅加速度传感器、陀螺仪等传感器数据？
如何使用C/C++订阅传感器数据？
如何正确订阅和取消订阅传感器数据以避免内存泄漏？
如何监听动态传感器设备的上下线事件？
如何使用ArkTS或C/C++控制设备振动？
如何查询和控制多个振动器设备？
如何监听动态马达设备的连接和断开事件？
如何实现自定义振动效果？
当你需要从设备传感器获取原始数据来开发应用时，应使用Sensor Service Kit的传感器模块
典型场景包括利用加速度传感器开发计步器、利用陀螺仪开发指南针、利用温度传感器监测环境温度、利用接近光传感器实现自动亮灭屏等
当你需要为应用添加振动反馈效果时，应使用Sensor Service Kit的振动模块
它支持预设振动效果和自定义振动模式，适用于游戏震动反馈、通知振动提醒、触摸振动反馈等场景
对于外接设备的振动控制，动态马达能力提供了灵活的管理方案
订阅加速度计和陀螺仪数据来实现摇一摇或体感控制 / Subscribe to accelerometer and gyroscope data for shake detection or motion control
实时读取设备传感器原始数据并在界面上显示 / Read raw device sensor data in real time and display it in the UI
接入方向传感器和重力传感器实现姿态识别 / Integrate orientation and gravity sensors to implement posture detection
监听传感器数据变化并按需停止监听以节省功耗 / Listen for sensor updates and stop listening when needed to save power
用 ArkTS 订阅环境光或接近传感器数据 / Subscribe to ambient light or proximity sensor data with ArkTS
用 C++ 注册传感器监听回调获取连续采样数据 / Register sensor listener callbacks in C++ to receive continuous sampled data
检测外接动态传感器的接入和移除并更新功能状态 / Detect dynamic sensor attachment and removal and update feature availability
查询设备支持哪些传感器并按能力启用对应功能 / Query which sensors the device supports and enable features by capability
控制手机或穿戴设备振动反馈来提示操作结果 / Control vibration feedback on phone or wearable devices to indicate operation results
管理多个振动器并为不同场景触发不同震动模式 / Manage multiple vibrators and trigger different vibration patterns for different scenarios
实现自定义振动节奏用于通知提醒或游戏反馈 / Implement custom vibration patterns for notifications or game feedback
监听动态马达设备上下线并切换振动输出目标 / Listen for dynamic motor device connection changes and switch vibration output targets
do_not_use_when: 需求是获取经纬度、GNSS/WLAN/蓝牙融合定位、地理围栏触发或地址解析，应改用 location-kit / The requirement is to obtain coordinates, use GNSS/WLAN/Bluetooth positioning, trigger geofences, or perform address lookup; use location-kit instead
需求是展示地图底图、添加标记/覆盖物、进行POI搜索或驾步骑公交路径规划，应改用 map-kit / The task is to render map views, add markers/overlays, perform POI search, or plan driving, walking, cycling, or transit routes; use map-kit instead
preconditions: 目标设备具备所需的传感器或振动器硬件能力，且系统版本支持对应 Sensor Service Kit 接口 / The target device has the required sensor or vibrator hardware capability, and the OS version supports the relevant Sensor Service Kit APIs
如访问的传感器涉及受保护能力，应用已在 module.json5 中声明相应权限并获得用户授权 / If the accessed sensor requires protected capability, the app has declared the relevant permission in module.json5 and obtained user consent
项目已正确引入 Sensor Service Kit 对应的 ArkTS 或 C/C++ 接口依赖，并具备可编译运行的环境 / The project has correctly added the Sensor Service Kit ArkTS or C/C++ dependencies and has a working build/runtime environment
inputs: 传感器类型、采样周期或订阅参数 / Sensor type, sampling interval, or subscription parameters
传感器事件回调或监听器对象 / Sensor event callback or listener object
振动效果参数、持续时间或自定义振动模式 / Vibration effect parameters, duration, or custom vibration pattern
目标振动器或动态设备标识 / Target vibrator or dynamic device identifier
outputs: 传感器数据回调对象（如加速度、陀螺仪、温度、接近光等原始采样值及时间戳） / Sensor data callback objects, such as raw accelerometer, gyroscope, temperature, proximity/light samples with timestamps
传感器信息对象或列表（传感器类型、名称、厂商、版本、量程、分辨率、功耗等元数据） / Sensor information object or list, including sensor type, name, vendor, version, range, resolution, power and other metadata
动态传感器设备上下线事件对象 / Dynamic sensor device online/offline event objects
单次传感器采样结果 / One-shot sensor sampling result
C/C++传感器事件结构体（传感器ID、时间戳、数据数组、数据长度等） / C/C++ sensor event structures containing sensor ID, timestamp, data array and data length
C/C++传感器信息结构体数组 / C/C++ sensor information structure arrays
振动执行结果或异步完成回调 / Vibration execution result or asynchronous completion callback
预设振动效果支持性查询结果（布尔值） / Preset vibration effect support query result as a boolean value
振动器信息对象或列表（振动器ID、设备ID、名称、能力等） / Vibrator information object or list, including vibrator ID, device ID, name and capabilities
动态马达设备连接和断开事件对象 / Dynamic vibrator or motor connection and disconnection event objects
自定义振动模式执行结果 / Custom vibration pattern execution result
接口调用错误码或BusinessError异常对象 / API error codes or BusinessError exception objects

postconditions.statement: 已添加传感器订阅或取消订阅逻辑，并与指定的传感器类型或监听器对应 / Sensor subscription or unsubscription logic is added and tied to the specified sensor type or listener
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit add code that registers or unregisters a sensor listener/subscription for a concrete sensor type or callback?

postconditions.statement: 已添加振动控制代码，使用了预设效果或自定义振动参数，并指向目标振动设备或默认振动器 / Vibration control code is added using a preset effect or custom vibration parameters, targeting a specific vibrator device or the default vibrator
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit add code that starts, configures, or stops vibration with explicit effect/pattern parameters and an intended vibrator target?

postconditions.statement: 对长期监听场景已补充资源释放或停止监听处理，避免持续订阅未清理 / For long-lived listening scenarios, cleanup or stop-listening handling is added to avoid uncleared subscriptions
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the edit introduces ongoing sensor listening, does it also include corresponding cleanup, stop, or unsubscribe handling?
